springBeans.checkProxyMethods.title: Warn when @Transactional, @Async, @Cacheable and similar annotations sit on private, final or static methods

springBeans.checkScheduled.title: Warn when a @Scheduled method declares parameters

springBeans.checkDuplicateNames.title: Warn when two beans of the project share a name

springBeans.checkConfiguration.title: Warn about private or final @Bean methods in proxied @Configuration classes

springBeans.checkNaming.title: Hint when an explicit bean name starts with a capital letter

springBeans.checkSelfInvocation.title: Warn when a method calls a @Transactional, @Async or @Cacheable method of its own class (text-based, may miss or over-report)

springBeans.checkUnresolvedReferences.title: Warn about @DependsOn names no project bean defines and @ComponentScan packages without sources (beans from libraries and auto-configuration are invisible, so this may over-report)

springBeans.checkAop.title: Report incomplete AOP configuration (aop:config, pointcuts, aspects, advisors, advice) in Spring XML files

springBeans.checkInjectionAnnotations.title: Report @Autowired, @Value, @Inject and @Resource on static members and conflicting @Autowired constructors

springBeans.checkXml.title: Run the other checks on Spring XML configuration files
